name: Process Inbox Received
description: Manual or scheduled processing of stored Inbox messages through typed event handlers.

files.description: Loads received messages, dispatches them, and records processing status.
Registers typed application handlers for incoming event contracts.
Routes envelopes to registered handlers by event type and version.
Exposes Start, Stop, and Flush for Inbox processing.
Decodes envelope content into the typed event expected by a handler.
Configures received message limits and cron or interval scheduling.
Defines received message loading and Inbox status updates.
